t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each colour pair has a higher reward, keep with these colours.Sometimes they will switch and be getting lower rewards, so swap for the other colour.Ignore the zero values. Don't make decisions based on just three mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: There are tall, short mushrooms and different colours as well as multipliers. Sometimes the tall ones pay more , sometimes the short ones do. Also trial and error pick whichever colours to see which ones pay out more as it can vary at times.
